verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a model-hosting and inference platform like Hugging Face, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of a self-hostable Hub or Inference Providers deployment. What it does show is adjacent and earns no credit: downloading model weights (snapshot_download), managed Inference Endpoints and Spaces, and jobs run on Hugging Face infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
